summary.boundary: This matrix converts audited experiment findings into software policy, diagnostic switch, and blocker decisions. It does not add CFD results or upgrade the official Case E metric.

rows.finding: Case A smoke regression guards the Rhino/GH -> FluidX3D -> VTK workflow but is not accuracy validation.
rows.implementation_evidence: release_gate and reproducibility_suite require Case A smoke regression before formal release.
rows.limitations: Do not use as wind-field accuracy validation.

rows.finding: Official z=2 m validation remains negative: MAE=21.111408125 pp, R2=-2.006330362229977, Pearson=0.11575649438573923.
rows.implementation_evidence: release_gate.json and paper_evidence_gate keep formal v0.4.0 blocked.
rows.paper_use: Use as negative validation and motivation for limitations.
rows.limitations: Cannot claim predictive accuracy, mesh independence, LES improvement, or formal v0.4.0.

rows.finding: The formal Case E protocol must remain z=2 m, 80 ac+N probes, and raw_trilinear sampling.
rows.implementation_evidence: SimulationSettings.FormalSamplingMode defaults to raw_trilinear and manifests block diagnostic substitutes.
rows.limitations: Protocol correctness alone is not accuracy evidence.

rows.finding: Diagnostic nu_lbm sensitivity is useful for investigation but has not produced a formal official z=2 m pass.
rows.implementation_evidence: Grasshopper nuLBM input defaults to 0 and SimulationSettings defaults to 0.0.
rows.limitations: Do not promote tuned nu_lbm as a default accuracy model.

rows.finding: Vertical-origin and probe sampling diagnostics expose near-wall/protocol sensitivity but remain non-formal.
rows.implementation_evidence: Grasshopper zOff defaults to 0 and run manifests forbid z_plus_half as formal output.
rows.limitations: Do not report z_plus_half, vertical_valid_above, or z-offset results as official validation.

rows.finding: The next official Case E run is blocked by runtime and load-identity gates.
rows.paper_use: Use to explain why no new official long run is reported in this rc.
rows.limitations: Operational readiness evidence only; not solver-output evidence.

rows.finding: TUM2TWIN layers are separated into visual reference, semantic/collision geometry and CFD/LBM simulation inputs.
rows.implementation_evidence: Experiment 3 archive and claim verification document the layer separation policy.
rows.paper_use: Use as CityLBM-compatible digital-twin workflow evidence.
rows.limitations: Does not prove Case E benchmark accuracy or CityLBM-GH end-to-end execution for Experiment 3.

rows.finding: Basic morphology variables are interpretable screening descriptors; sector enclosure ranks above single-building footprint/elongation.
rows.implementation_evidence: citylbm_paper_results_packet keeps Experiment 3 screening evidence separate from Case E accuracy evidence.
rows.limitations: Sample-internal screening only; no field validation or annual comfort compliance.

rows.finding: Run Simulation exposes the generated citylbm_run_manifest.json path as a Grasshopper output for direct reviewer tracing.
rows.implementation_evidence: Manifest Path output points to citylbm_run_manifest.json and the manifest records formal/diagnostic claim boundaries.
rows.paper_use: Use as software traceability evidence for run manifests and protocol metadata.
rows.limitations: Traceability output only; does not prove Rhino loaded the new GHA or improve official z=2 m accuracy.

rows.experiment: Experiment 2 / AIJ Case E paper-readiness layer
rows.finding: Run manifests and manuscript result rows now record allowed paper uses and forbidden accuracy claims.
rows.implementation_evidence: citylbm_run_manifest.json includes paper_readiness fields and casee_manuscript_results_table separates formal and diagnostic rows.
rows.paper_use: Use to move Case E results into manuscript tables without overstating formal accuracy.
rows.limitations: Paper-readiness metadata does not change the official z=2 m metric or permit formal v0.4.0.

rows.experiment: Experiment 2 / AIJ Case E paper-figure layer
rows.finding: The manuscript result table is exported as an editable SVG/PNG/source-CSV figure bundle with QA checks.
rows.implementation_evidence: casee_paper_results_figure_qa.json verifies source CSV, editable SVG, PNG export, and negative-validation claim boundary.
rows.paper_use: Use as a paper figure for negative validation and limitations only.
rows.limitations: Figure output does not add CFD results, improve official z=2 m metrics, or justify formal accuracy claims.

rows.experiment: Experiment 2 / AIJ Case E manifest gate contract
rows.finding: Generated run manifests now encode the formal v0.4.0 accuracy-gate contract and keep manifest-only accuracy claims blocked.
rows.implementation_evidence: WriteRunManifest emits formal_accuracy_gate with required official protocol, release-gate, Case A, Rhino/GHA, R2/Pearson, and diagnostic-substitute constraints.
rows.paper_use: Use as software traceability evidence that each generated case records the formal release-gate contract.
rows.limitations: Manifest-gate metadata does not add solver output, improve official z=2 m metrics, or permit formal v0.4.0.

rows.experiment: Experiment 2 / AIJ Case E Grasshopper claim boundary
rows.finding: Run Simulation now exposes a Claim Gate output so users can see the formal accuracy boundary beside run status and manifest path.
rows.implementation_evidence: RunSimulationComponent adds Claim Gate output index 7 and sets it in generate, deploy, full-auto, async, cancelled, running, and no-run states.
rows.paper_use: Use as software misuse-prevention evidence: successful execution is separated from formal benchmark accuracy.
rows.limitations: UI claim-boundary text does not add solver output, improve official z=2 m metrics, or prove Rhino loaded the new GHA.

rows.experiment: Experiment 2 / AIJ Case E manuscript prose layer
rows.finding: The generated section pack converts gated Case E rows into Methods, Results, Diagnostics, Limitations, Software implications, and Release-boundary prose with explicit evidence notes.
rows.implementation_evidence: casee_manuscript_section_pack.py emits a claim-safe English manuscript section pack and QA manifest from the gated results table and release gate.
rows.paper_use: Use as ready-to-edit manuscript prose for negative validation, diagnostic interpretation, limitations, and release-boundary text.
rows.limitations: Generated prose does not add CFD output, improve official z=2 m metrics, or support a formal predictive-accuracy claim.

rows.experiment: Build-chain recovery / Case E follow-up readiness
rows.finding: The current build-chain audit records .NET and FluidX3D as available, GPU runtime as ready, and VS Build Tools C++ as blocked after a winget BuildTools attempt exited 1602 with UAC-related bootstrapper evidence.
rows.implementation_evidence: build_chain_audit.py now captures latest winget/VS installer logs, vswhere VC detection, GPU status, .NET status, FluidX3D binary status, and disk state.
rows.paper_use: Use as environment/build-chain evidence explaining why another full software/native validation loop still requires manual VS C++ recovery.
rows.limitations: Build-chain readiness does not add CFD output, improve official z=2 m metrics, prove Rhino loaded the new GHA, or permit formal v0.4.0.

rows.experiment: Experiment 2 / AIJ Case E dx=1 follow-up readiness
rows.finding: The dx=1 m high-resolution official follow-up is a high-risk long-run candidate: readiness=high_risk_blocked_until_dry_run, memory_headroom_ok=False, moderate required per GPU=13.79 GiB, minimum free GPU memory=15.898 GiB.
rows.implementation_evidence: casee_dx1_readiness_audit.py records the audited dx=1 command, generated-domain dimensions, GPU free memory, memory scenarios, and no-run claim boundary.
rows.paper_use: Use as high-resolution follow-up feasibility and limitations evidence.
rows.limitations: Readiness evidence only; no dx=1 solver output, no official z=2 m metric improvement, and no mesh-independence claim.

rows.experiment: Experiment 2 / AIJ Case E wall and roughness follow-up
rows.finding: Near-wall underprediction and solid-corner diagnostics justify a default-off wall/roughness follow-up interface, but the official z=2 m raw_trilinear metric has not improved enough to promote any wall model as a default accuracy setting.
rows.implementation_evidence: Grasshopper wallModel defaults to none, z0Wall defaults to 0.0, generated setup.cpp records audit constants only, and run manifests block default accuracy promotion.
rows.paper_use: Use as software-feedback evidence that Case E diagnostics were converted into controlled follow-up interfaces.
rows.limitations: No wall-model or roughness setting is a formal validation result until completed official z=2 m raw_trilinear runs pass the release gate.

rows.experiment: Experiment 2 / AIJ Case E manifest schema traceability
rows.finding: Generated run manifests need a stable reader-facing schema so Case E protocol fields, diagnostic substitute blockers, and paper-forbidden claim classes can be audited without reinterpreting solver logs.
rows.implementation_evidence: citylbm_manifest_schema_gate.py verifies required manifest sections, official Case E contract fields, diagnostic blockers, wall/roughness default-safety fields, and paper-forbidden claims.
rows.paper_use: Use as reviewer-facing manifest schema and claim-boundary evidence.
rows.limitations: Schema traceability does not add CFD output, improve official z=2 m metrics, or permit a formal accuracy claim.
